headlines.title: Why Strategy (MSTR) stock is up today
headlines.summary: Shares of bitcoin development company Strategy (NASDAQ:MSTR) jumped 7.1% in the afternoon session after the company's board increased its securities buyback capacity to $3 billion and analysts raised their price targets.

headlines.title: Strategy Soars 7%, Galaxy Up 8% as Crypto Stocks Rally on “Clear, Practical Framework” for Stablecoin Rules
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysStrategy rose 7% and Galaxy Digital 8% today as crypto stocks rallied after the OCC finalized its GENIUS Act stablecoin rules, with Strive up 14%, Circle 5% and Coinbase 4%. The rules govern stablecoin issuers like Circle, so Strategy’s jump mostly reflects its leveraged exposure to bitcoin, which rose about 3%.

headlines.title: Strategy Increased Its Preferred Stock Buyback to $3 Billion and Shares Moved Higher. What This Means for MSTR
headlines.summary: Strategy raised its preferred-stock repurchase authorization to $3 billion on Oct. 19 after spending $193.1 million in one week to buy back STRC shares below par.

headlines.title: What Is Strategy (MSTR)? The Bitcoin Treasury Company
headlines.summary: Strategy’s co-founder Michael Saylor pioneered the Bitcoin treasury playbook. Here’s what you need to know.

description: Strategy Inc, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a bitcoin treasury company in the United States, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and internationally. It offers investors varying degrees of economic exposure to Bitcoin by offering a range of securities, including equity and fixed income instruments. The company also provides AI-powered enterprise analytics software, including Strategy One, which provides non-technical users with the ability to directly access novel and actionable insights for decision-making. In addition, the company provides Strategy Mosaic, a universal intelligence layer that offers enterprises with consistent definitions and governance across data sources, regardless of where that data resides or which tools access it. The company was formerly known as MicroStrategy Incorporated and changed its name to Strategy Inc in August 2025. The company was incorporated in 1989 and is headquartered in Tysons Corner, Virginia.
